verdict: The best strategy depends on the hardware: ZX teleport on IBM Kolkata, IBM Miami, IonQ Forte; Qiskit O3 on IBM Sherbrooke, IBM Fez.
ZX teleport cut non-Clifford phases from 28 to 16 without restructuring the circuit (2Q gates 33 -> 27).
ZX full rebuilt the circuit from its graph and came out with more 2Q gates (33 -> 44); circuit extraction trades structure for compactness.
Routing is the hidden cost: on IBM Fez (heavy-hex) 28% of 2Q gates are SWAP overhead; on IonQ Forte (all-to-all) it is 0%.
IBM Kolkata: ZX teleport is best (est. success 0.74, +4.5 pts vs Qiskit O3 (44 -> 44 2Q gates)); ZX full is worst (0.49).
IBM Sherbrooke: Qiskit O3 is best (est. success 0.69); ZX full is worst (0.59).
IBM Fez: Qiskit O3 is best (est. success 0.83; tied with ZX teleport); ZX full is worst (0.72).
IBM Miami: ZX teleport is best (est. success 0.86, +1.5 pts vs Qiskit O3 (42 -> 36 2Q gates)); ZX full is worst (0.79).
IonQ Forte: ZX teleport is best (est. success 0.87, +1.4 pts vs Qiskit O3 (29 -> 25 2Q gates)); ZX full is worst (0.81).
